name: 71-user-intent-outcome
body:
[71-user-intent-outcome] Full outcome + next effect

Desired behavior
Every required behavior → result; substantial action → checkable one-step-ahead prediction.

Executable contract
1. Outcome, conditions, criterion from the instruction. General/quantified requirements define the coverage set regardless of the list found; coverage open until a sufficient systematic search closes it.
2. Before action: sufficient model - input/condition → affected state, owner, boundaries → observable effect → next dependent behavior. Significant edge case + how a wrong implementation would differ included. Simple change → short local model.
3. Existing sufficient abstraction used; close one extended instead of a simplified copy. guard/fallback/retry/cache or a new layer only for a concrete requirement, a reachable substantial failure or proven complexity of the existing mechanism.
4. One coherent checkable fragment executed, inspected, fixed; independent parallel work gets its own scope/owner/checks. After the edit, actual behavior vs prediction.
5. Before finishing: result vs whole instruction, corrections, mandatory gates. New instances of a general requirement already in scope under edit authority. Simplicity = mechanism, completeness = every property.

Tools and skills
Contracts + callers read on target; graph tools desirable for a complex dependency. Runtime/native UI or direct text read mandatory per outcome kind. A requested task skill defines stages + ownership.

Links: 01-operating-principle, 70-reasoning-poison, 73-tests-not-proof, 74-use-context-frontier, 81-engineering-invariants.

Anti-patterns
Ready fragment as the whole task; found files as global scope; new mechanism by habit; fallback losing the verified property; difficulty as permission to underdeliver.
